results.prompt: If my future wife has the same first name as the 15th first lady of the United States' mother and her surname is the same as the second assassinated president's mother's maiden name, what is my future wife's name?
evidence: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harriet_Lane (15th First Lady Harriet Lane 的母亲为 Jane Ann Buchanan → first name Jane)
https://www.nps.gov/people/eliza-ballou-garfield.htm (Garfield 母亲 Eliza Ballou，maiden name Ballou)
results.note: 参数知识路线（Jane Pierce → Elizabeth Means）会答错为 Amelia Ballou；检索链路找到正确口径 Harriet Lane 后答对——multi-hop 检索价值的直接案例。首轮 base 查询遇 429 全损。

results.prompt: Which section of IPSC Australia Inc. is larger than Honshu and smaller than Sumatra by area?
